deadline.value: The ECE PhD page gives no application deadline.

gre_general.value: GRE General is not required for the ECE PhD.
gre_general.quote: The General Graduate Record Examination (GRE) Aptitude Test scores are not required for admission

supervisor.value: Applicants are admitted based on research interests and openings in an ECE research group, so a group match comes before admission.
supervisor.quote: All applicants are admitted based on their research interests and openings in the ECE research groups

funding.value: Assistantships cover tuition, stipend and health insurance, but the page does not say how many admitted students get one.
funding.quote: Assistantships provide tuition, stipend and health insurance

entry_route.value: A BS and/or MS in Electrical and Computer Engineering or a related discipline is accepted.
entry_route.quote: BS and/or MS degree in Electrical and Computer Engineering or related disciplines

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Application is started at https://www.slu.edu/apply.php, which could not be fetched; English rules follow the university record.
